metadata.description: Knowledge base for Herbal-AI skin disease prediction system.

diseases.label: Acne
diseases.description: Acne is a common skin condition that develops when hair follicles become clogged with oil, dead skin cells, and bacteria. It commonly appears on the face, chest, shoulders, and back.

recommended_herbs.name: Neem
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply diluted neem oil or fresh neem leaf paste to the affected area.

recommended_herbs.name: Tulsi
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply fresh tulsi leaf extract using a clean cotton pad.

recommended_herbs.name: Turmeric
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Mix turmeric powder with honey or yogurt to make a paste and apply for 10–15 minutes before rinsing.

self_care: Wash your face twice daily with a gentle cleanser.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if acne becomes severe, painful, leaves scars, or does not improve with regular skincare.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Actinic Keratosis
diseases.description: Actinic keratosis is a rough, scaly patch of skin caused by long-term exposure to ultraviolet (UV) rays. It is considered a precancerous skin condition.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the patch grows, bleeds, becomes painful, or changes in appearance.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Benign Tumors
diseases.description: Benign skin tumors are non-cancerous growths that usually grow slowly and do not spread to other parts of the body.
self_care: Monitor for changes in size or color.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the growth becomes painful, bleeds, changes rapidly, or interferes with daily activities.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Bullous Disease
diseases.description: Bullous diseases are skin conditions that cause fluid-filled blisters due to damage within the layers of the skin. Some types require prompt medical treatment.
self_care: Keep affected areas clean and dry.
Protect the skin from friction and injury.
Follow wound care instructions if blisters rupture.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist immediately if blisters are widespread, painful, infected, or accompanied by fever.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Candidiasis
diseases.description: Candidiasis is a fungal infection caused by an overgrowth of Candida yeast. It commonly affects warm and moist areas of the skin.
symptoms: Small red bumps around the rash

recommended_herbs.name: Karanj
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Dilute Karanj oil with coconut oil before applying to the affected area.

recommended_herbs.name: Neem
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply diluted neem oil or neem leaf paste to the affected area.

recommended_herbs.name: Tulsi
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply fresh tulsi leaf extract using a clean cotton pad.

self_care: Keep the affected area clean and dry.
Avoid sharing towels or personal items.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if the infection spreads, recurs frequently, or does not improve after treatment.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Drug Eruption
diseases.description: Drug eruption is a skin reaction caused by certain medications. Symptoms usually appear after starting a new medicine and may vary from mild to severe.
self_care: Do not stop prescribed medicines without medical advice.
Keep the skin cool and clean.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Seek immediate medical attention if the rash is severe, spreads rapidly, causes blistering, facial swelling, or difficulty breathing.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Eczema
diseases.description: Eczema is a chronic skin condition that causes dry, itchy, and inflamed skin. It often occurs in flare-ups and may be triggered by allergens, irritants, or environmental factors.

recommended_herbs.name: Aloe Vera
benefits: May help keep the skin moisturized
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply fresh Aloe Vera gel directly to clean skin.

recommended_herbs.name: Karanj
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Dilute Karanj oil with coconut oil before applying to the affected area.

recommended_herbs.name: Giloy
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Prepare a cooled Giloy decoction and gently wash the affected skin.

diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if eczema becomes severe, infected, spreads, or does not improve with regular skin care.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Infestations & Bites
diseases.description: Infestations and insect bites are skin conditions caused by insects, mites, or parasites. They often lead to itching, redness, and skin irritation.
self_care: Apply a cold compress to reduce itching.
Use insect repellents to prevent future bites.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if the swelling becomes severe, signs of infection develop, or symptoms do not improve.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Lichenoid Disorders
diseases.description: Lichenoid disorders are inflammatory skin conditions that cause itchy, flat-topped, purple-colored skin lesions. They may affect the skin, nails, or mouth.
self_care: Avoid products that irritate the skin.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the rash spreads, becomes painful, or affects the mouth or nails.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Lupus (Cutaneous)
diseases.description: Cutaneous lupus is an autoimmune skin condition that commonly causes red, scaly rashes, especially on areas exposed to sunlight.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if new rashes appear, symptoms worsen, or you experience joint pain or persistent fatigue.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Moles / Nevi
diseases.description: Moles are common pigmented skin growths. Most are harmless, but changes in their size, shape, or color should be evaluated by a dermatologist.
self_care: Protect your skin from excessive sunlight.
Avoid scratching or injuring the mole.
Take photographs to monitor changes over time.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if a mole changes in size, shape, color, starts bleeding, or becomes painful.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Psoriasis
diseases.description: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune skin condition that causes skin cells to build up rapidly, forming thick, red, scaly patches. It is not contagious but often occurs in flare-ups.

recommended_herbs.name: Karanj
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Dilute Karanj oil with coconut oil and apply gently to affected areas.

recommended_herbs.name: Giloy
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Prepare a cooled Giloy decoction and gently wash the affected skin.

recommended_herbs.name: Neem
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply diluted neem oil or neem leaf paste to affected areas.

diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the patches spread, become painful, crack severely, or interfere with daily life.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Rosacea
diseases.description: Rosacea is a long-term skin condition that mainly affects the face, causing redness, visible blood vessels, and sometimes acne-like bumps.

recommended_herbs.name: Aloe Vera
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply fresh Aloe Vera gel to clean skin.

recommended_herbs.name: Turmeric
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Mix turmeric powder with honey to form a paste and apply for 10 minutes before rinsing.

recommended_herbs.name: Giloy
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Prepare a cooled Giloy decoction and gently rinse the affected skin.

self_care: Avoid spicy foods if they trigger symptoms.
Limit alcohol intake if it worsens redness.
Avoid very hot water on the face.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if redness worsens, eye symptoms develop, or home care does not improve the condition.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Seborrheic Keratoses
diseases.description: Seborrheic keratoses are common non-cancerous skin growths that usually appear as brown, black, or tan raised spots.
self_care: Protect the area from repeated friction.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the growth changes rapidly, bleeds, or becomes painful.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Skin Cancer
diseases.description: Skin cancer is the uncontrolled growth of abnormal skin cells, often caused by long-term exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation. Early diagnosis is important for successful treatment.
self_care: Protect your skin from excessive sunlight.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Seek immediate evaluation from a dermatologist if you notice a new, changing, bleeding, or non-healing skin lesion.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only. Herbal remedies should not be used as a substitute for professional diagnosis or treatment of skin cancer.

diseases.label: Sun / Sunlight Damage
diseases.description: Sun damage occurs due to prolonged exposure to ultraviolet (UV) rays, leading to premature aging, pigmentation, sunburn, and an increased risk of skin cancer.

recommended_herbs.name: Aloe Vera
benefits: May help keep the skin moisturized
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply fresh Aloe Vera gel to the affected area 2–3 times daily.

self_care: Apply sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher.
Avoid direct sunlight during peak hours.
Wear protective clothing and a hat.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if you develop severe sunburn, large blisters, fever, or signs of heat illness.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Tinea
diseases.description: Tinea is a common fungal skin infection that causes itchy, ring-shaped rashes. It can affect different parts of the body including the feet, scalp, groin, and body.

recommended_herbs.name: Neem
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply diluted neem oil or neem leaf paste to clean, dry skin.

recommended_herbs.name: Karanj
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Dilute Karanj oil before topical application.

self_care: Keep the affected area clean and dry.
Wash hands after touching the affected area.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if the infection spreads, becomes painful, or does not improve with treatment.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Unknown / Normal
diseases.description: The uploaded image does not show a recognizable skin disease or does not contain enough information for a reliable prediction. The skin may appear normal or require a clearer image.
self_care: Keep your skin clean and moisturized.
Upload a clearer image if you need another analysis.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a healthcare professional if you notice persistent skin changes, pain, or unusual lesions.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: AI predictions are not a medical diagnosis. Always seek professional medical advice if you have concerns.

diseases.label: Vascular Tumors
diseases.description: Vascular tumors are abnormal growths formed from blood vessels. Many are benign, but some require medical evaluation.
self_care: Monitor for changes in size or color.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if the lesion grows rapidly, bleeds repeatedly, or becomes painful.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Vasculitis
diseases.description: Vasculitis is inflammation of blood vessels that can affect the skin and other organs. Skin symptoms often appear as red or purple spots.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Seek medical care immediately if you develop severe pain, fever, numbness, or rapidly worsening skin lesions.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Vitiligo
diseases.description: Vitiligo is a long-term condition in which patches of skin lose their pigment due to the destruction of melanocytes. It is not contagious.

recommended_herbs.name: Bakuchi
benefits: May support skin pigmentation when used under medical supervision
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Use only under the guidance of a qualified healthcare professional.

recommended_herbs.name: Giloy
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Consume or use only as advised by a qualified practitioner.

diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a dermatologist if pigment loss spreads rapidly or affects your quality of life.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.

diseases.label: Warts
diseases.description: Warts are small, rough skin growths caused by infection with the human papillomavirus (HPV). They are generally harmless but can spread through direct contact.

recommended_herbs.name: Neem
recommended_herbs.preparation_method: Apply diluted neem oil to the affected area.

self_care: Do not pick or scratch warts.
Cover the wart if it is likely to come into contact with others.
diseases.when_to_consult_doctor: Consult a doctor if the wart is painful, bleeds, spreads rapidly, or does not improve with treatment.
diseases.medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and should not replace professional medical advice.
